column7: Existing {project_id: 0, environment_id: X} grants (written before #3546; not migrated, by decision) made X's project access review read as complete while a grant that applies there was missing from it. GenerateProjectAccessReview (and every campaign snapshot) is now degraded with one reason per such grant naming it and the fix; the startup notice names all of them (server TestWireGlobalProjectRoleGrantsNotice_LogsEnvironmentWithoutProjectGrants); end to end: server/http TestProjectAccessReviewHTTP_NamesEnvironmentWithoutProjectGrantUntilFixed. Red with the flag call removed.
